setup: Use existing isolated Compose, Node test, Playwright, ESLint, TypeScript, c8 and fast-check. No dependencies, schema migrations or commits.
behaviors: Unilock special and regular backorder requests have Live Stock Check on the right of Line responses; other vendors do not.
Each eligible line displays its own queued, checking, In stock, Low inventory, Next Production with ISO ETA, unavailable or failed result beside ETA and pickup.
A result opens that exact job and private evidence, even when older than the latest 30 checks.
Only exact vendor SKU or a unique complete name/colour/size match is selected automatically; ambiguous descriptions require SCM catalogue selection.
Selections and results survive reload through job metadata; changed product, quantity or vendor requires a fresh check.
Concurrent clicks reuse active jobs for the same line and fingerprint; a batch validates atomically and queues at most 100 checks.
Request lines, manual ETA, pickup, supply decisions, orders and revision remain unchanged.
Only SCM-authorized users can read or queue checks and evidence; crafted lines, products, fingerprints and non-Unilock vendors are rejected.
Transient GET failures retry at most twice and record retries; POST actions and semantic failures are never replayed.
Existing partial shipment postbacks, delayed date navigation, lower availability evidence and zero cart writes remain covered.

failureModel.wrongVariantOrStaleResult: Exact matching, SCM selection, immutable line fingerprint, adversarial matching tests
failureModel.duplicateOrPartialBatch: Database transaction, vendor queue lock, concurrent calls and rollback tests
failureModel.crossRequestLeak: SCM router authorization, server-owned request/line/product lookup, browser request-switch race test
failureModel.portalInstability: Bounded read-only retries, recorded diagnostics, adapter fixture failure injection
failureModel.hostOrDeployment: Registered disposable test teardown, bounded Compose, captured live source overlay, exact-image boot and automatic rollback
